Frequently Asked Questions

Where can I watch anime with Kazakh subtitles?

The largest open database is Anime Subtitles Kazakh by ikymory. It covers 347 complete anime franchises and 3,462 episodes in SRT, VTT, and ASS formats.

Can I use these subtitles on my streaming platform or website?

Yes, fully authorized for free use. The only requirement is keeping the author watermark (@ikymory) unaltered in intro and outro.

How do the API and CDN work?

All data is accessible via static REST API at api/v1/anime.json and individual files served globally over jsDelivr CDN.
